## 注意 Notice

**_本工具靠 wizwalker 掛入（注入）遊戲程序讀取聊天，違反 Wizard101 服務條款，可能導致帳號被停權，請自行斟酌。_**

**_This tool injects into the game process (via wizwalker) to read chat, which violates the Wizard101 Terms of Service and may get your account banned. Use at your own risk._**

**_本工具會讀取遊戲記憶體並監聽全域熱鍵，行為模式與部分惡意程式相似，可能被防毒軟體誤判並刪除／隔離；請自行評估後加入白名單，本工具保證無毒。_**

**_Because it reads game memory and listens for a global hotkey, antivirus software may flag or quarantine it. This is a false positive; add it to your allowlist if you decide to use it. This software is guaranteed to be virus-free._**

## 回報問題 Reporting Issues

請附上 exe 旁的 `app.log`（訊息漏翻／重複翻譯的問題請一併附上 `messages.log`）：<https://github.com/GoneTone/wizard101-chat-translator/issues>

Please attach the `app.log` next to the exe (and `messages.log` for missing or duplicated translations): <https://github.com/GoneTone/wizard101-chat-translator/issues>
